subject.title: refactor(config): config-surface reduction tranche 2 — purge tuning knobs behind built-in defaults

question: Should this config-reduction tranche remove behavior-changing operator policies, or only internal numeric defaults whose configured and unset behavior are equivalent?
rationale: The PR deliberately changes upgrade behavior for existing configurations, and the repository policy distinguishes policy/feature controls from internal tuning defaults; that boundary requires maintainer intent.

options.title: Retain behavior-changing controls
options.body: Keep the global health-monitor opt-out, worktree quota limits, and pre-OOM capture setting while merging the remaining true default-only reductions.

options.title: Approve their removal explicitly
options.body: Accept the upgrade behavior change and document a supported replacement or a deliberate deprecation path for each affected policy.

recommendation.title: Retain behavior-changing controls
recommendation.body: Keep the global health-monitor opt-out, worktree quota limits, and pre-OOM capture setting while merging the remaining true default-only reductions.

likelyOwner.reason: The current PR author is the only supplied person directly connected to this configuration-surface decision.
